analyses.name: BvFTD versus Controls (decrease in white matter integrity)
analyses.description: Tract-based spatial statistics: regions showing decreased white matter integrity in BvFTD compared with Controls. Tracts: Inferior longitudinal fasciculus, uncinate fasciculus, inferior fronto-occipital fasciculus, superior longitudinal fasciculus, anterior thalamic radiation, forceps minor, forceps major, cingulum (cingulate gyrus), cingulum (hippocampal part), superior longitudinal fasciculus (temporal part). Side: Bilateral. Number of voxels: 64,986. Results corrected with TFCE, FWE p<.05.

analyses.name: AD versus Controls (decrease in white matter integrity)
